works.title: Nocturne
works.desc: A fashion short shot after midnight — sodium light, wet asphalt, and a frame held longer than it should be. Graded to keep the dark breathing.

works.title: Grain & Light
works.desc: A textile campaign built around one window and one afternoon. The cloth does the moving; the camera stays still.

works.title: Seoul, 4AM
works.desc: A vertical diary of the hours when the city is only signage and rain. Shot on a walk home, assembled from what the night kept.

works.title: Static Bloom
works.desc: An anemone, one lamp, and a shutter left open a beat too long. Part of an ongoing study of red.

works.title: Concrete Prayer
works.desc: A chapel corridor at 4pm. The only light in the room is a slot the architect cut on purpose.

works.title: Blue Hour, Apt. 402
works.desc: Dusk arriving in a rented apartment, ten minutes before the lamps were switched on.

works.title: Salt & Chrome
works.desc: Steel, salt and a single strip of light — a product study about reflection rather than the object.
